title: Jamshedpur, Jharkhand — Cost of Living, Housing & Relocation Guide [2026]
description: Complete guide to Jamshedpur, Jharkhand: cost of living, home prices, neighborhoods, remote work readiness, and relocation tips.
content:
Overview

Jamshedpur is a city in Jharkhand with a population of 1,350,000. India’s first planned industrial city, home to Tata Steel, known for its lush greenery, lakes, and high quality of life. Housing costs are close to the national average. The overall cost of living is below the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 6b growing zone supports Cool to mild — apples, pears, berries, many vegetables. The population skews young, with a median age of 28.0.
